app.title: Nietzschian Debugger
app.author: dilawargopang
app.description: A debugging tool for Rust that provides an interactive REPL and source-level stepping.
proposed_tests: Clone repository and run `cargo build` to ensure compilation succeeds
Execute the `nzd` binary with `--help` and verify the output
Launch the debugger on a sample Rust project and confirm that breakpoints and stepping work
